**Faster and cheaper** brought us to open source.<br>Going **further** is the bigger promise.

::: notes
"The stud wasn't standardized to make bricks cheaper. It made possible everything people went on to build."

0:50. Four clicks.

Click: the left side. A set box with a castle on the lid, the same castle built, and a stopwatch. "Faster and cheaper is the same castle, sooner." Be generous: that was a fine reason to come to R, and it paid off.

Click: the right side. Two different sets, two towers. "Further starts when two sets meet."

Click: the bridge. Each set reaches halfway, and one brick on top holds both halves. "No box had this. The stud made it possible." It's the shape of what comes next: one programmer pooling two studies.

Click: "Faster and cheaper brought us to open source. Going further is the bigger promise." Then, warmly: "This isn't SAS, rewritten in R. That world ended in folders too." Move straight to the picture.
:::
